questions.q: An IFSC code used in electronic fund transfers contains how many characters?
questions.solution: The Indian Financial System Code is 11 characters: 4 letters for the bank, a zero, and 6 characters identifying the branch (e.g. SBIN0007245).
questions.shortcut: IFSC = 11; MICR cheque code = 9 digits.

questions.q: Android, the mobile operating system, is built on which kernel?
questions.solution: Android uses the Linux kernel at its core with Java/Kotlin application layers on top - a standard exam fact.
questions.shortcut: Android = Linux kernel; iOS/macOS = Darwin (UNIX-based).

questions.q: UPI, the instant real-time payment system, is developed and operated by:
questions.solution: UPI (2016) is built and operated by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), the umbrella organisation for retail payments (it also runs IMPS, RuPay, BHIM). RBI regulates but does not operate UPI.
questions.shortcut: NPCI runs the retail rails: UPI, IMPS, RuPay, AePS. RBI is the regulator.

questions.q: The full form of POST, the diagnostic routine that runs when a computer is switched on, is:
questions.solution: POST = Power-On Self-Test: the BIOS/UEFI checks RAM, keyboard, disk controllers etc. before handing over to the boot loader. A failed POST usually beeps.
questions.shortcut: 'Self-Test' is the giveaway - any option without 'Self-Test' is wrong.

questions.q: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number (3).
questions.solution: The contrast is 'decoration rather than ___', and the passage argues trees are functional city assets — cooling, dust-trapping, noise-softening. The noun for functional city assets is **infrastructure**. *Entertainment, souvenir, ceremony* fit the grammar but belong to no part of the argument.
questions.shortcut: Contrast frame 'X rather than Y' wants Y from the same serious category as the argument — trees as urban equipment.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the highlighted segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution required'.

He has been living in Chennai **since** 2015 and has no plans to move.
questions.solution: *Since* + point of time with a continuing perfect is standard: rungs 1–4 find no fault. *For* needs a duration (*for nine years*), *from* and *by* do not pair with this perfect. → **No substitution required**.
questions.shortcut: Since = point, for = span. The original is standard; trust it.

questions.q:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Open the gate.
questions.solution: An imperative converts with **Let + object + be + V3**: 'Let the gate be opened.' B produces a statement, not an order; C lacks the auxiliary; D uses the adjective 'open' instead of V3 'opened'.
questions.shortcut: Imperative anchor: Let + object + be + V3.

questions.q:
Choose the correct order of the parts to make a meaningful sentence.

**1.** The sun had set behind the hills. **P:** Soon the stars appeared one by one. **Q:** A cool breeze began to blow. **R:** The villagers gathered under the banyan tree. **S:** The eldest among them told stories of the old days. **6.** Night after night, this ritual continued.
questions.solution: Scene continues: breeze (**Q**) → gathering (**R**, 'them' = villagers) → stars appear (**P**, 'Soon') → the eldest tells stories (**S**) → ritual (**S6**). QRPS.
questions.shortcut: 'Among them' needs the villagers first; 'Soon' rides after the gathering.

questions.q: Which statement about the GST Council is correct?
options: It is chaired by the Prime Minister
States together carry one-third of the voting weight
Decisions require a two-thirds special majority of members present
Decisions are taken by a three-fourths weighted majority, with the Centre holding one-third weight
questions.solution: Under Art. 279A the Council is chaired by the **Union Finance Minister**, and every decision needs a **3/4th weighted majority — Centre 1/3, States together 2/3**; quorum is half the members.
questions.shortcut: Weights: 1/3 Centre + 2/3 States = 3/4 decision rule.

questions.q: Who was named the Most Valuable Player of IPL 2026?
questions.solution: Rajasthan Royals' 14-year-old sensation **Vaibhav Sooryavanshi** topped the run charts with 776 runs and was named MVP. Kagiso Rabada (29 wickets) took the Purple Cap.
questions.shortcut: Orange Cap + MVP went to the same player: Sooryavanshi, 776 runs.

questions.q: The **Knesset** is the parliament of —
questions.solution: The **Knesset** is Israel's unicameral legislature in Jerusalem. Iran – Majlis, Japan – Diet, Norway – Storting.
questions.shortcut: **K**nesset – Hebrew for 'assembly' – Israel.

questions.q: The novel ***Godan*** was written by —
questions.solution: ***Godan*** (1936), Premchand's last completed novel, tells the story of the poor farmer Hori. Premchand also wrote *Gaban* and *Nirmala*.
questions.shortcut: Godan–Gaban–Nirmala = Premchand trio.

questions.q: In what ratio should a 25% acid solution be mixed with a 50% acid solution to obtain a 40% acid solution?
questions.shortcut: Cross the distances from the mean 40 ⇒ 2 : 3.

questions.q: A train 250 m long, running at 45 km/h, crosses a man walking at 5 km/h in the opposite direction in:
questions.solution:
$S_{\text{rel}} = 50$ km/h $= \frac{125}{9}$ m/s.
$t = 250 \times \frac{9}{125} = 18$ seconds.
questions.shortcut: Opposite directions add: 50 km/h; 250 ÷ (125/9) = 18 s.

questions.q: The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one more number 37 is included, the new average is:
questions.solution:
Old sum $= 135$. New sum $= 135 + 37 = 172$.
New average $= \frac{172}{6} = 28.5$.
questions.shortcut: 37 is 10 above the old average; the extra 10 spreads over 6 numbers: 27 + 10/6 = 28.5.

questions.q: What is the unit digit of $(2137)^{754}$?
questions.solution: Unit digit of base = 7. $754 \bmod 4 = 2$ → $7^2 = 49$ → unit digit **9**.
questions.shortcut: Only the last two digits of the exponent matter: 54 ÷ 4 leaves 2.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: **41, 51, 53, 59**
questions.solution: 41, 53, 59 are prime; **51 = 3 × 17** is composite.
questions.shortcut: 51 is a stock fake prime (3 × 17); divide by 3 when in doubt.
questions.pattern: number odd one out — prime vs composite

questions.q:
Find the missing number:

**4   7   22**

**6   3   18**

**9   5    ?**
questions.solution: 22 = (4+7)×2; confirm 18 = (6+3)×2 ✓. Rule: third = (first + second) × 2. So (9+5)×2 = **28**. (45 is 9×5 — the product trap.)
questions.shortcut: Large third cell with modest inputs → try (a+b)×k or a×b first.
questions.pattern: single grid, rows share a rule

questions.q: **|A ∩ B| = 8, |A − B| = 10, |B| = 20 and 7 elements belong to neither set.** What is the size of the **universal set** (all elements considered)?
questions.shortcut: Four disjoint regions: both, A-only, B-only, neither.

questions.q: Select the related word: **Japan : Yen :: Bangladesh : ?**
questions.solution: Relation: country to its **currency**. Bangladesh's currency is the **taka**. Rial → Oman/Saudi Arabia, Dinar → Kuwait/Jordan, Kyat → Myanmar.
questions.shortcut: Currency bank: Japan-yen, Bangladesh-taka, Myanmar-kyat, Mongolia-tugrik, Vietnam-dong.
questions.pattern: word analogy from the standard relation bank
